data.revised_prompt:
Edit the provided scientific-educational vector-style method figure, preserving the overall wide 3:1 composition, white background, pastel palette, clean aligned boxes, and left-to-right flow. Keep the three main regions exactly: depth preprocessing on the left, flight branch on the upper right, camera branch on the lower right. Preserve the flight branch structure unchanged, including F_f stem, W_s, LayerNorm + gated fusion, GRU_f, W_u without sigmoid, and u_t. Preserve the depth preprocessing region unchanged. Preserve G_c as a parallel adapter receiving Phi_t directly.

Primary correction: make the camera branch more accurate by showing z_t^c as a true three-input fusion. In the camera branch, draw three visible inputs into z_t^c: (1) a direct residual arrow from F_c stem to z_t^c, (2) a second arrow from F_c stem to A_c adapter (residual), then from A_c adapter to z_t^c, and (3) the G_c adapter feeding z_t^c in parallel. Keep the camera branch uncluttered and avoid crossing arrows.

Keep c_t -> W_c and m_t -> W_m as separate inputs to concat. Keep the camera branch ordering and modules the same, with no new modules added. Do not add sigmoid to W_u. Do not change the flight branch structure. If possible, change the final camera output label to lowercase: c*_{t+1} = [P,E,G]. Keep labels large and horizontal. Maintain the same clean vector-like style, rounded dashed border for the camera branch, and avoid crowding, extra labels, extra equations, decorative icons, watermarks, misspelled variables, or style changes.
